clue.text: Backing for singer during quiet drink? That's OK

parts.note: P (piano) is the musical abbreviation for quiet

indicators.note: during means one piece sits in the middle of the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink

indicators.note: backing means the singer's word is turned around, read from the back

parts.note: a bass is a low male singer

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a quiet drink while supporting a singer is acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing for' makes SSAB; 'during' puts it within the drink. 'Backing' looks like musical support for a singer, but it signals the turnaround.
explanation.definitionFit: Something passable is adequate, merely satisfactory, which is what 'That's OK' says.

clue.text: Ready assistance on boards?

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means ready, quick to act
on the boards (stage) a forgotten line is supplied by a cue from the wings

explanation.definitionFit: Prompt means both punctual and ready, and the help given to an actor who forgets a line.

clue.text: Ken, say, being devious and cunning

indicators.note: devious means taking a winding route, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: A man named Ken, for example, is crooked and sly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sneaky means sly and underhand, the same as cunning.

clue.text: A single girl out of order

parts.note: Miss is the title for an unmarried girl or woman

explanation.surface: An unmarried young woman is behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Amiss means wrong or faulty, the same as out of order.

clue.text: Learner with printing requirement to get on connection

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate
ink is needed for printing
to age is to get on in years

explanation.surface: A trainee with print supplies is told to get on with linking things.
explanation.definitionFit: A linkage is a link or connection between things.

clue.text: Substitute man making decisions about story

indicators.note: about means the referee's letters go round the story

parts.note: the referee, REF, makes the decisions in a match
a lie is a made-up story

explanation.surface: A stand-in official gets embroiled in some tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A relief is a replacement who takes over from someone on duty, a substitute.

clue.text: Questionable peer entertaining four with promoted company

indicators.note: entertaining means the peer holds the other pieces inside

parts.note: a peer is one's equal
IV is four in Roman numerals

indicators.note: promoted in a down clue means raised, so the company's letters read upwards

explanation.surface: A dubious nobleman hosts four guests from a firm on the up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promoted' makes OC, since in a down clue the letters rise; 'entertaining' has the peer hold the numeral and company.
explanation.definitionFit: Equivocal means ambiguous or open to doubt, so questionable.

clue.text: Woman facing wasted years? It's quite possible

parts.note: Ida is a woman's name

indicators.note: wasted means the letters of years are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman confronting years she has squandered thinks it entirely likely.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase 'I dare say' concedes that something is probably so.

clue.text: Indulge in aerial activity and test public opinion?

definitions.meaning: to send a kite up into the air on a string
an idiom for floating an idea to see how people react

explanation.definitionFit: Flying a kite literally sends one aloft, and idiomatically means testing reactions to a proposal.

clue.text: Award given by name in assembly following orders?

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: in puts the name inside the assembly

parts.note: a diet is a formal legislative assembly

explanation.surface: Someone gets an honour and is named before a parliament for doing as told.
explanation.definitionFit: An obedient person complies, doing what they are ordered to do.

clue.text: Choppy sea for one in landing-place making one nauseous

indicators.note: in places the shuffled letters inside what remains of the landing-place
for one means the shuffled sea letters stand in place of a single A, the one, in the landing-place

parts.note: a quay is a landing-place for boats

indicators.note: choppy, describing rough water, signals the letters of sea are tossed about

explanation.surface: Rough water at the dock leaves a passenger feeling sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Choppy' turns SEA into EAS, which replaces A ('for one', A being one) 'in' QUAY: QU-EAS-Y. 'making one' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Queasy is a synonym for nauseous, feeling sick in the stomach.

clue.text: Measure gluey material

definitions.meaning: a dimension or magnitude of something
a gelatinous solution used to stiffen or glaze paper and cloth

explanation.definitionFit: Size means dimensions, and is also a glue-like sealant used on paper and plaster.

clue.text: A tank is renovated in keeping of good Asian

indicators.note: in keeping of means the reworked letters are held inside good

parts.note: PI, short for pious, means good in crosswords

indicators.note: renovated means the words a tank is are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: An old tank is restored under the care of a virtuous person from Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'renovated' makes AKISTAN, and 'in keeping of' sets it inside the pious letters; PI meaning good is a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: A Pakistani is a person from Pakistan, a country in South Asia.

clue.text: Part of gear that's very new and latest in streetwise athletic stock

indicators.note: latest in picks the final letter from each of the three following words

explanation.surface: Part of some sports kit is described as very new, the latest in street-smart athletic merchandise.
explanation.definitionFit: A V-neck is a style of jumper or top, so part of what one wears, one's gear.

clue.text: Trailer in outskirts of jungle — and old horse

indicators.note: in puts the trailer inside those edge letters
outskirts of takes only the edge letters of jungle

parts.note: a trailer is an advertisement for a film, an ad

explanation.surface: A film preview set on the edge of the jungle features an aged horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A jade is an archaic word for a worn-out or broken-down horse.

clue.text: Car keys lost around river, old site down under

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters go about the other pieces
lost means the letters of car keys are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone loses their car keys near a river at an ancient Australian site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' rearranges CAR KEYS to AYERSCK, which goes 'around' RO.
explanation.definitionFit: Ayers Rock, now Uluru, is a huge sandstone landmark in Australia, the land down under.

clue.text: Northern Church worker after start of Easter showing delight

indicators.note: after means the rest of the pieces follow that first letter
start of takes the first letter of Easter

parts.note: an ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A northern church volunteer is delighted once Easter begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To enchant is to charm or delight someone; both are verbs.

clue.text: Name in leading ship showing formality

indicators.note: in puts the name inside leading

parts.note: prime means leading or foremost
SS, steamship, is a ship

explanation.surface: A name appears on the lead vessel, showing proper ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: Primness is stiff, prudish formality of manner.

clue.text: Derisive remark about newfangled kits for aquatic sportsman

indicators.note: about means the jeer goes round the rearranged letters

parts.note: a jeer is a mocking remark

indicators.note: newfangled means the letters of kits are made over in a novel order

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at modern gear for a water-sports enthusiast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'newfangled' makes TSKI, and 'about' wraps the mocking remark round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A jet-skier rides a jet ski, a small motorised craft, on the water.

clue.text: Line mentioned by academic authority in girls' school

indicators.note: mentioned means the word for line is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a row is a line
a dean is a senior university official

explanation.surface: A college dean brings up a dispute concerning a girls' school.
explanation.walkthrough: ROEDEAN is a famous English girls' boarding school near Brighton.
explanation.definitionFit: Roedean is a well-known independent boarding school for girls in Sussex, England.

clue.text: Amphibian beginning to wriggle in trap

indicators.note: in puts that letter inside the trap

parts.note: a net is a trap

indicators.note: beginning to takes the first letter of wriggle

explanation.surface: A small creature starts to squirm once caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A newt is a small salamander, a tailed amphibian.

clue.text: Some wax left in car part

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bit of wax has been left inside a car component.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took 'in car part'; 'in' is only a link, so the definition is 'car part'.
explanation.definitionFit: An axle is the rod on which a vehicle's wheels turn, a component of a car.

clue.text: Do a stretch of rowing, we hear? Great

indicators.note: we hear means the phrase is spoken, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: to oar some is to row a while, joking on oar as a verb

explanation.surface: A rower finishes a session and is told it was wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: Awesome is slang for great or excellent.

clue.text: Fodder, one in fashion

indicators.note: in puts the one inside fashion

parts.note: to forge is to fashion or shape
A means one

explanation.surface: Animal feed is, for a single person, the latest trend.
explanation.definitionFit: Forage is food for livestock such as hay or grass, so fodder.

clue.text: Withdraw City journalist in the Home Counties

indicators.note: in puts the city and journalist inside the region

parts.note: the Home Counties around London are in the South East, SE
EC is the postal district of the City of London
ED, editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A financial reporter pulls out to live in the commuter belt around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in South East England.
explanation.definitionFit: To secede is to withdraw formally from a union or federation.

clue.text: Leader of evangelicals enthralled by model OT figure

indicators.note: enthralled by means the letter is held captive inside the model

parts.note: Kate Moss is a famous fashion model

indicators.note: leader of takes the first letter of evangelicals

explanation.surface: A top evangelical is captivated by a supermodel.
explanation.definitionFit: Moses is a central figure of the Old Testament who led the Israelites from Egypt.

clue.text: European in backward part of ship, say, individual looking dismal

indicators.note: in puts the European inside the reversed ship part
backward means the ship part is read in reverse

parts.note: the bow is the front part of a ship
EG, for example, is what say means
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A European at the back of a ship, for example, looks miserable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backward' turns BOW into WOB, and E goes 'in' it to give WOEB.
explanation.definitionFit: Woebegone describes someone sad or miserable in appearance, looking dismal.

clue.text: Try written composition

definitions.meaning: an attempt, as a verb to attempt something
a short piece of prose writing on a subject

explanation.definitionFit: Essay means an attempt as well as a short piece of writing.

clue.text: Inventor, head of department, is seen in time

indicators.note: seen in means the pieces appear inside the period of time

parts.note: an eon is a long period of time

indicators.note: head of takes the first letter of department

explanation.surface: A department head is spotted in his time as an inventor.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Edison was the American inventor of the phonograph and a practical light bulb.

clue.text: Patient figure hears fantastic opportunity for work?

parts.note: Job is the biblical figure famed for patience

indicators.note: fantastic means the letters of hears are wildly rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient person hears about a wonderful chance of employment.
explanation.definitionFit: A job share splits one post between two people, giving each an opening for employment.

clue.text: Part of rally and run held in Potteries town

indicators.note: held in puts the run inside the town

parts.note: Stoke-on-Trent is the main town of the Potteries, the pottery-making district of Staffordshire
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Part of a motor rally and a race take place in a Staffordshire town.
explanation.walkthrough: STOKE is Stoke-on-Trent, heart of the Potteries in England; a rally here is a tennis exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis a rally is a series of shots, each a single hit of the ball.

clue.text: By the sound of it, man with thin fabric

indicators.note: by the sound of it means the spoken pieces are what count, not their spelling

parts.note: Terry is a man's name and lean means thin, so together they say TERRY LEAN

explanation.surface: A man with a skinny frame is seemingly made of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Terylene is a British trade name for a polyester synthetic textile.
